title: A GitHub comment body that is a bare shell substitution is refused
why: The MCP comment tool runs no shell, so a body like `$(cat file)` posts as that literal text. Hit twice at 07:34 CST Nov 8, on #1551 and #1914; both junk comments were relabelled and the real records posted below (lane notes-fix-large-3).
note: Done check: a red test where the guard refuses an MCP comment or review body that is only a `$(...)` or backtick substitution, and passes a body that quotes one inside prose. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage.
